notes: Micromonas mesnili Borrel, 1902 (Thompson prints 'Bonel'), a minute parasitic flagellate; the GBIF backbone keeps Micromonas Borrel, 1902 only as a doubtful protozoan genus. Not to be confused with the green alga Micromonas Manton & Parke, 1960, which is what NCBI and Wikidata return; those identifiers are therefore left null. GBIF backbone marks this name DOUBTFUL. Treated as an animal by Thompson; not Metazoa in modern taxonomy (see lineage).
